close_reason: civil_from_days returns Option<(i32, u8, u8)>; now_utc_string falls through to clock-out-of-range sentinel on None. Added civil_from_days_returns_none_on_year_overflow with i64::MAX/MIN derived inputs plus i32-fitting positive control. Test verified to catch the panic (fails when fix reverted to expect).
description:
crate-jmap-server/src/helpers.rs:214-230 — civil_from_days uses i32::try_from(yr).expect("year bounded by SystemTime-driven input to i32"). The accompanying doc claims "callers driven by SystemTime cannot exceed that" — true for sane clocks, but the outer now_utc_string sentinel only catches u64 > i64::MAX seconds (about ±2.9e11 years). Inputs between the i32-year boundary (~5.7e6 years from epoch, ~1.8e14 seconds) and the i64::MAX sentinel (~2.9e11 years) DO reach civil_from_days and panic.

Trigger: SystemTime::now() returns a value with secs in roughly [1.8e14, 9.2e18). Reachable via NTP malfunction, container date manipulation, hardware RTC corruption, or a guest VM whose host clock drifted absurdly forward. The dispatcher worker panics; under task::spawn isolation in lib.rs, the panic surfaces as serverFail rather than crashing the process — so the practical impact is degraded to "every handler that calls now_utc_string returns serverFail until the clock is fixed". Still a correctness gap because the function is documented as returning the "clock-out-of-range" sentinel in this regime.

Fix: replace the inner expects with a fallible return path: change civil_from_days to return Option<(i32, u8, u8)> and have now_utc_string fall through to UTCDate::from("clock-out-of-range") on None, matching the existing sentinel contract. Or tighten the outer sentinel to reject any secs whose magnitude exceeds the i32-year boundary before calling civil_from_days. Either approach restores the documented contract that this function returns a string rather than panicking on adversarial clock input.

Test: a unit test for civil_from_days with z = i64::MAX / 86400 (or similar near-overflow value) that asserts None / sentinel rather than panicking. The current test suite (civil_from_days_known_dates in helpers.rs:407) only covers sane dates.
title: civil_from_days year overflow panics on corrupted-clock secs near i64 limits
